Edit the FIRST input image, the gray orthographic guide. The SECOND input is design_reference.png, used ONLY as the colour/material/design authority, never as the camera or shape authority.

Small blue-white lens only on the raised lens mount already present in the guide. Follow the approved design's panel joins, seams and engraved lines as painted surface details; no added geometry. Do not copy the glossy lighting of the design reference. Fine material texture must remain subtle.
No background, floor, text, letters, labels, numbers, logo, watermark or layout sheet. One isolated painted view, same position and scale as its guide, nothing outside its silhouette and nothing cropped.
